title: Running Commentary on Torah 30 — Mishra d'Sakina
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 30 — מישרא דסכינא
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **The ma'amar**: Athenians: **'mishra d'sakina, b'mai kat'lei lah?'** ('A field of knives — with what do you reap it?'). Answer: **'b'karna d'chamra'** ('with the horn of a donkey'). They: 'is there a horn to a donkey? and is there a field of knives?' Then: **'aitu lah trei bi'ei. Amru: hei zug'sa chivarsa v'hei zug'sa uchamsa?'** (They brought two eggs: which is from the white hen, which from the black?). R"Y: **'aiti tre geveinei.'** (He brought two cheeses.) **'Amar l'hu: hei d'iza chivarsa v'hei d'iza uchamsa?'** (Which from the white goat, which from the black?).

intermediate.en: **Bechoros 8b — field of knives**: with what reap? **horn of donkey**! mutually absurd. Then **two eggs** (white/black hen?) → R"Y: **two cheeses** (white/black goat?) — absurdity mirrored.
intermediate.he: **בכורות ח: — מישרא דסכינא**: במה קוצרין? **בקרן חמור!** אבסורד הדדי. אח"כ **ב' ביצים** (לבנה/שחורה?) → ר"י: **ב' גבינות** (עז לבנה/שחורה?) — סתירה משתקפת.

beginner.en: **Rashi**: **b'mai kat'lei lah** = **a bed of knives, how do you cut/reap it?**

intermediate.en: Rashi: bed of knives — how cut/reap?

beginner.en: **"א. **Hasagos Elokus** cannot be attained except via **many tzimtzumim** — **ma'alah l'alul**, **sechel elyon to sechel tachton**. As we see: one cannot grasp **sechel gadol** except via **hisl'bshus in sechel tachton**. A teacher explaining great sechel to a student must **clothe it in a small/low sechel** — offering introductions and small sechels that lead him up to the main point (= sechel elyon)."**

intermediate.en: **α. Hasagos Elokus via many tzimtzumim** (ma'alah→alul; sechel elyon→tachton). Teacher → low sechel first → leads to main.
intermediate.he: **α. השגות אלוקות ע"י צמצומים רבים** (מעלה→עלול; שכל עליון→תחתון). מורה → שכל נמוך → מוביל לעיקר.

beginner.en: **"ב. Each must seek greatly a **teacher fit** enough to explain such sechel elyon via sechel tachton. One needs **a very great rebbi** for this — the more katan and distant from Hashem, the greater the rebbi he needs. As Israel were on the **49 sha'arei tum'ah** in Mitzrayim — they needed **Moshe, the greatest rebbi**, who could descend from supernal heights to the lowest, to teach them hasagos Elokus."**

intermediate.en: **β. Must seek great teacher** — the smaller/more distant the student, the greater the rebbi needed. Mitzrayim (49 sha'arei tum'ah) → needed **Moshe** (the greatest rebbi).
intermediate.he: **ב. חיפוש רבי גדול** — ככל שהתלמיד קטן/רחוק, רבי גדול יותר. מצרים (מ"ט שערי טומאה) → **משה** (הרבי הגדול).

scholarly.he: סעיף ב. משה, מ"ט שערי טומאה.

beginner.en: **"ג. Bechina of **se'aros** (hairs) — the mochin's illumination comes forth through **hairs**. So the sechel elyon (hasagos Elokus) clothes in sechel tachton. **'Sa'ara b'igula'** (Tikkun 70, 113) = circular hair = **sibbuvim** = **hakdamos that circle** until reaching the **main point**. Chazal (Yevamos 16b) — they circled him with halachos until they reached **tzaras ha'bas** (= the main point); all prior halachos were **sibbuvim v'hakdamos**."**

intermediate.en: **γ. Se'aros**: mochin exit via hairs; sechel elyon clothed in tachton. Tikkun 70 (113) **"sa'ara b'igula"**=sibbuvim=hakdamos. Yev 16b: circling halachos → tzaras ha'bas (main point).
intermediate.he: **ג. שערות**: מוחין יוצאים דרך שערות; שכל עליון מלובש בתחתון. תיקון ע (קיג) **"שערא בעיגולא"**=סיבובים=הקדמות. יב' טז:: הסתיבבו בהלכות → צרת הבת (עיקר).

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. תיקון ע קיג; יב' טז:.

beginner.en: **"**'Bas haisah lo l'Avraham Avinu u'v'kol shmah'** (Bava Basra 16b). **'Bas'** = **bas ayin** = the **shachor shel ha'ayin** (pupil's blackness) — bechina of **shachrus** (above): it **contracts, delimits, and contains within itself** all the great things standing opposite. A **great mountain** before the bas ayin — contained entirely within her shachrus; via this **contraction**, the thing is seen/grasped. So too **sechel elyon contracts into sechel tachton.**"**

intermediate.en: **"Bas haisah l'Avraham"** (BB 16b): bas=**bas ayin**=shachor shel ha'ayin contracts+contains great things → seen/grasped. Sechel elyon→sechel tachton via same tzimtzum.
intermediate.he: **"בת היתה לו לאברהם"** (ב"ב טז:): בת=**בת עין**=שחור העין מצמצם+כולל גדולים → ראייה/השגה. שכל עליון→תחתון ע"י אותו צמצום.

beginner.en: **"**'Va'yeira elav Hashem b'labbas eish'** (Shemos 3:2): HKBH wanted to clothe hasagos Elokus for Moshe — He clothed it in **bas ayin** (Tikkunim 6, 11, 70). **'Bas techilah, siman yafeh la'banim'** (Bava Basra 141a): **bas techilah** = sechel tachton (first, as hakdamah); **banim** = sechel elyon. Chazal (Menachos 110a) on **'havi'i banai mei'rachok u'venosai mi'ktzeh ha'aretz'** (Yeshayahu 43:6) — **banim** = sechel elyon; **banos** = sechel tachton."**

intermediate.en: **"Va'yeira elav Hashem b'labbas eish"** (Shem 3:2): Elokus clothed in **bas ayin** (Tikkunim 6, 11, 70). **"Bas techilah, siman yafeh la'banim"** (BB 141a) = bas/tachton hakdamah → banim/elyon. Yesh 43:6.
intermediate.he: **"וירא אליו ה' בלבת אש"** (שמ' ג, ב): אלוקות מלובשת ב**בת עין** (תיקונים ו, יא, ע). **"בת תחילה, סימן יפה לבנים"** (ב"ב קמא.) = בת/תחתון הקדמה → בנים/עליון. יש' מג, ו.

scholarly.he: שמ' ג, ב; תיקונים ו/יא/ע; ב"ב קמא.

beginner.en: **"ד. To reach sechel tachton only via **sonei betza** (hater of unjust gain; Shemos 18:21). **Se'ara uchama = sechel tachton** — from the **mi'sitra d'malchus**. **Sonei betza**=also from mi'sitra d'malchus (Tikkun 70). **Sechel tachton = malchus = chochmah tata'ah** of each olam, guiding that olam. Therefore in Shmuel's days, when **rashei ha'dor** fell into **'va'yit'u b'nei Shmuel'** — **'va'yitu acharei ha'betza'** (Shmuel I 8:3) — they pogmed malchus/chochmah tata'ah → needed Shmuel to restore via soneh betza."**

intermediate.en: **δ. Sechel tachton requires sonei betza** (Shem 18:21). Se'ara uchama=sechel tachton=mi'sitra d'malchus (Tikkun 70). Shmuel's dor: betza→pgam malchus ("va'yitu acharei ha'betza," Sh"A 8:3).
intermediate.he: **ד. שכל תחתון דורש שונא בצע** (שמ' יח, כא). שערא אוכמא=שכל תחתון=מסטרא דמלכות (תיקון ע). דור שמואל: בצע→פגם מלכות ("ויטו אחרי הבצע", ש"א ח, ג).

scholarly.he: סעיף ד. שמ' יח, כא; ש"א ח, ג.

beginner.en: **"ה. One with this chochmah must draw **chiyus** into her = **or panim** — **'b'ohr pnei melech chayim'** (Mishlei 16:15). Must **raise malchus/chochmah tata'ah to ohr ha'panim** shining in the **3 regalim**. Ikkar ohr ha'panim = **simchah** — **'lev sameach yeitav panim'** (Mishlei 15:13). Ikkar simchah from **mitzvos** — **'simchu tzaddikim ba'Hashem'** (Tehillim 32:11) — and especially on the regalim: **'v'samachta b'chagecha'** (Devarim 16:14)."**

intermediate.en: **ε. Draw chiyus into malchus/chochmah tata'ah = or panim** (Mishlei 16:15). Raise to or panim of **3 regalim**. Simchah=ikkar or panim (Mishlei 15:13); mitzvos (Teh 32:11); regalim (Dev 16:14).
intermediate.he: **ה. המשכת חיות לחכמה תחתונה = אור פנים** (מש' טז, טו). העלאה לאור פנים של **ג' רגלים**. שמחה=עיקר (מש' טו, יג); מצוות (תה' לב, יא); רגלים (דב' טז, יד).

scholarly.he: סעיף ה. מש' טז, טו; טו, יג; תה' לב, יא; דב' טז, יד.

beginner.en: **"ו. Sometimes malchus d'kedushah/chochmah tata'ah **falls** into **galus of the 4 malchuyos**. Malchus = **daleth** (**'d'leis lah mi'garmah klum,'** Zohar Vayechi 238, 249) — has nothing of her own except branches of sechel elyon spreading into her. Also comprised of **4 olamos** (each olam's malchus/chochmah tata'ah). All umos' chochmos are below this tata'ah, drawing their chochmos from her. When she falls into galus of 4 umos, each umah takes a portion, and must be **cut out and separated** from them."**

intermediate.en: **ζ. Malchus falls into galus 4 malchuyos.** Malchus=**daleth** ("leis lah mi'garmah," Zohar Vayechi 238, 249) branches of elyon. Comprises 4 olamos. Umos draw from her → must cut/separate.
intermediate.he: **ו. מלכות נופלת לגלות ד' מלכויות.** מלכות=**דל"ת** ("לית לה מגרמה", זוה"ק ויחי רלח, רמט) ענפי עליון. ד' עולמות. אומות יונקות ממנה → להפריד.

beginner.en: **"ז. Ikkar hisgalus ha'chesed (by which one harvests the daleth from the 4 umos) is via **tochachah**. Via the mochiach's **pesichas peh**, **chochmah** is revealed; via chochmah, chesed is revealed. **'Kel nehiru d'chochmesa'** (Zohar Lech Lecha 94a). **'Piha pascha b'chochmah, v'soras chesed al leshonah'** (Mishlei 31:26). **'Yehalmeini tzaddik chesed v'yochicheini'** (Tehillim 141:5) — tochachas tzaddik = chesed."**

intermediate.en: **η. Ikkar hisgalus chesed via tochachah**. Peh pesichas → chochmah → chesed (Zohar Lech Lecha 94a "Kel nehiru d'chochmesa"; Mishlei 31:26; Teh 141:5).
intermediate.he: **ז. גילוי חסד ע"י תוכחה**. פתיחת פה → חכמה → חסד (זוה"ק לך לך צד. "אל נהירו דחכמתא"; מש' לא, כו; תה' קמא, ה).

scholarly.he: סעיף ז. זוה"ק לך לך צד.; מש' לא, כו; תה' קמא, ה.

beginner.en: **"ח. How can one rebuke each individual? All tefilos come together — of kesheirim and non-kesheirim — how does he know which prayer is from whom? He knows via **each one's azus and Torah** — whether his tefilah was k'hogen or not. Two types of **azus**: **azus d'kedushah** (impossible to receive Torah except via it — Avos 2:5: **'lo ha'bayshan lameid'**) and azus d'sitra achra. Distinction by azus + Torah."**

intermediate.en: **θ. Mochiach discerns individual tefilos** via each one's **azus+Torah** (2 azus: kedushah vs sitra achra; Avos 2:5 "lo ha'bayshan lameid").
intermediate.he: **ח. מוכיח מבחין תפילות פרטיות** ע"י **עזות+תורה** של כל אחד (ב' עזות: קדושה/סט"א; אבות ב, ה "לא הבישן למד").

beginner.en: **"**Peirush**: **mishra d'sakina** = chochmah tata'ah = malchus — it is **'ha'hasken hisk'n'ti'** (Bamidbar 22:30) — lashon of **limud** (Targum: **'ha'milaf alifna'**); **'cherev nokemes'** (Vayikra 26:25) = malchus. **Mishra** (Rashi: arugah) = **'za'akas moshel'** (**'k'ayal ta'arog,'** Tehillim 42:2). **B'mai kat'lei lah** — with what is malchus cut out (from the 4 umos) to save her from za'akah? — **karna d'chamra**: chesed revealed via tochachah."**

intermediate.en: **Peirush**: **mishra d'sakina**=chochmah tata'ah=malchus ("hasken hisk'nti," Bam 22:30=limud; "cherev nokemes," Vay 26:25=malchus). **Arugah** (mishra)="za'akas moshel" ("k'ayal ta'arog," Teh 42:2). Cut via **karna d'chamra**=tochachah→chesed.
intermediate.he: **פירוש**: **מישרא דסכינא**=חכמה תחתונה=מלכות ("הסכן הסכנתי", במ' כב, ל=לימוד; "חרב נוקמת", ויק' כו, כה=מלכות). **ערוגה** (מישרא)="זעקת מושל" ("כאייל תערוג", תה' מב, ב). חותכין ע"י **קרנא דחמרא**=תוכחה→חסד.

scholarly.he: במ' כב, ל; ויק' כו, כה; תה' מב, ב.

beginner.en: **R"N editorial**: **"He began this Torah on the pasuk **'va'yehi mi'ketz...'** (Bereshis 41:1), but did not finish explaining the pasuk according to this Torah. He afterwards said: if he wanted to finish the peirush ha'pasuk, he'd need to say **another Torah like this** just to explain the pasuk."**

intermediate.en: R"N: Rabbeinu began on "va'yehi mi'ketz" (Ber 41:1), didn't finish — would need another Torah this size to explain.
intermediate.he: ר"נ: הרבי התחיל על "ויהי מקץ" (בר' מא, א), לא סיים — היה צריך תורה כזו נוספת לפירוש.

beginner.en: **"From a person's **kol** one can know his **bechina of malchus** — each has a bechina of malchus; it's recognized in his kol (no two kolos equal). By **kol**, one recognizes the bechina of malchus he has: **'kol anos gevurah, kol anos chalushah'** (Shemos 32:18). Therefore **Shaul pursued David** because of **malchus**. And via kol one recognizes the man — **"ha'kol kol Yaakov"** (Bereshis 27:22)."**

intermediate.en: From **kol** — know one's bechinah of **malchus** (no 2 equal; Shem 32:18 "kol anos gevurah, kol anos chalushah"). Shaul pursued David over malchus; "ha'kol kol Yaakov" (Ber 27:22).
intermediate.he: מ**קול** — יודע בחינת **מלכות** (אין ב' שווים; שמ' לב, יח). שאול רדף דוד על מלכות; "הקול קול יעקב" (בר' כז, כב).

scholarly.he: שמ' לב, יח; בר' כז, כב.
